mailArchive.keepsRunning: You can leave this page; the task keeps running and you'll be notified when it finishes.
mailArchive.title: Local mail library
mailArchive.localOnly: Imported mail is stored only on this device, separate from your server mailboxes. Reading, flagging, moving and deleting here never contact your mail provider, and mail can't be moved from here to a server mailbox. Libraries are kept even if you remove the original account.
mailArchive.searchScope: Searches only the selected folder in this library (sender, recipients, subject and text). Regular mail search doesn't include the library.
mailArchive.limits: Each import can include up to 64 files, 512 MB or 10,000 messages. Mail you've already imported is skipped automatically. Technical limits: up to 32 MB per message, 8 MB per body and 20 MB per attachment (24 MB of attachments in total). Duplicates are detected by identical message content, not by Message-ID.
mailArchive.confirmImport: Import into this local library? Nothing is uploaded and your source files aren't changed. If the import stops partway, messages already imported are kept; importing again skips them.
mailArchive.cancelled: Cancelled. Messages already imported or exported are kept; an unfinished MBOX export is discarded.
mailArchive.empty: No mail in this folder matches the search.
mailArchive.move: Move to folder in this library
mailArchive.deleteWarning: Permanently delete this message and its attachments from the local library? This can't be undone. Your server mailbox and the original import files aren't affected.
mailArchive.safePreview: Shown as plain text only: HTML, remote images and active content are never displayed here. Exporting keeps the original message, including HTML and attachments.
mailArchive.noPlainBody: This message has no plain-text version. Export it to view it in a trusted mail app.
mailArchive.mailboxNote: This exports mail, not the settings backup. Only mail and attachments already downloaded to this device are exported; nothing is fetched from the server, and messages with missing attachments are reported as failed. Existing files are never overwritten. Technical details: mailbox mail is rebuilt as standard MIME, library mail is exported unchanged, and MBOX files use the mboxrd format.
